profile.headline: Technical Lead | Lead Full Stack Engineer | Data Engineer | Java, Angular, AWS | Scalable Web, Data & API Systems | Product-Focused Engineer | FIRST Robotics Mentor | Building Reliable User Experiences
profile.summary:
As a Lead Full Stack Developer, I contribute over a decade of experience in Java, Agile methodologies, and SQL to deliver innovative enterprise applications. I work collaboratively with cross-functional teams to integrate modern web technologies, lead Agile projects, and oversee end-to-end development cycles to meet stakeholder priorities. My work includes leading enhancement efforts, leading pilot programs like the Tableau Reporting Program, and supporting migrations such as JBOSS and BIRT.  

My professional mission is to foster high-performing teams and guide them towards achieving technical excellence while driving customer satisfaction. With a steadfast commitment to mentoring future engineers through FIRST Robotics, I strive to inspire innovation in technology and education. Skilled in Agile leadership, I focus on delivering scalable, high-impact software solutions that streamline workflows and enhance operational efficiency.

positions.title: Lead Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Led an agile cross functional team of 6, across multiple time zones, collaborating with other cross teams, to deliver multiple Java enhancement initiatives in Spring and front end Angular, increasing data import workflow by 60% and increasing customer satisfaction.
Drove adoption of AI-assisted development tools (i.e. Copliot) to optimize coding, test automation, and requirements translation (Gemini), delivering a 30% reduction in development time across the team.
Held design meetings with stakeholders to create user approved solutions. Created documentation and requirements in JIRA and Confluence
Served as a Subject Expert for reporting applications and data to back end relations. 
Led a Tableau reporting pilot, establishing a foundation for modern data visualization and reporting.
Collaborated across product, DevOps, and architecture teams to integrate modern APIs and web technologies into legacy systems.
Managed an additional team of 6 engineers, mentoring individuals via one-on-ones, implementing employee retention and conducting performance reviews.
positions.insights: Skills: Product Design · Spring Framework · General Reporting · Large Scale Development · BIRT · Leading Development Teams · Tableau · Technical Project Leadership

positions.title: Master Software Developer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
Via quarterly Program Increment (PI) Planning identified sprint deliverables from the backlog to
effectively address stakeholder’s needs.
With other lead developers, attended weekly Technical Review Board (TRB) to review new code
changes to maintain integrity of code.
Developed and unit tested Java enhancements in Spring framework.
Partnered with DevOps for smooth major releases, deployments, and post-release support.
Directed Oracle to Postgres migration, with 10 cross-team engineers, updating 400+ Oracle SQL queries and delivering 250 reporting files with 95% on time delivery.
Remediated impediments, triaged bugs and assisted with User Acceptance Testing.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
Managed a very Agile team of 5-6 with tasks relative to coordinating successful monthly release cycles & out of cycle releases. Designed reports, developed solutions, divided tasks between team members, deployed reports via Jenkins to different environments, tested reports in several environments, code reviewed all parts of reports and oversaw deployed code releases to production. 
Provided support to all team members in project as well as other projects. Trained support desk, other developers and clients about new reports and how to use them prior to release.
Became Agile Scrum Master. Tracked day to day activities though JIRA's Greenhopper and started to use Fisheye/Crucible tools for peer code review. Held bi-monthly backlog grooming sessions with clients. Directed monthly sprint retrospectives, demos and planning meetings with the team during release cycles. 
Interviewed potential candidates for several positions within TechFlow. 
Designed report’s user interface with clients and other team members to fulfill client requirements. Implemented JavaScript, jQuery, jQuery UI and AJAX elements on top of BIRT functionality to promote responsive reports. Consistently maintained over 150 reports to stay relevant and generate quick upload time.
Developed and maintained a back end authentication system for reports through Java. Upgraded application layer to consistently stay up to date with other projects and use extra functionality features. Unit tested code for each authorizer to ensure healthy code.
Generated, optimized, and maintained queries in SqlDeveloper that fed data into reports. Developed materialized views, views, triggers, procedures and precise SQL to pull data in optimal time.
Tracked down defects through ServiceNow and direct feedback from clients. Used Splunk to trace errors internally.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
Led BIRT reporting team through releases; ensured stable delivery via Jenkins pipelines.
Conducted code reviews, training sessions, and CAB representation to safeguard continuity.
Designed user-friendly reporting interfaces using JavaScript, jQuery, and AJAX.
Translated Oracle Report Forms into BIRT reports, modernizing usability and accuracy.

positions.title: AVID Tutor
positions.description: Facilitate questions in group meetings with children to help them ask questions that lead them to the right answer. Graded binders, edited essays, and helped with test prep to prepare children (grades 7-12) for college.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design, develop, and unit test code in an agile and scrum environment.
During Scrum Master Role, managed burndown chart on company wiki, maintained backlogs and kept listed impediments low. 

Developed and optimized database schema and code projected for large amounts of customer and company data. 

Independently designed, structured and developed company website to HTML5 and CSS standards. Company website prepared for multiple screen sizes, including mobile. 

Implemented and developed an object-oriented database in (Apache) Cassandra. Used an apache Thrift interface to a Java client. Database intended to be used for many quick transactions. 

Unit tested and stress tested logic and presentation layers of code.. 

Developed and designed company product in a team environment. Created interface and logic layers of company products. 

Developed Windows and Web Services to start when product is turned on.

honors.title: Woodie Flowers Finalist Award
honors.description: The Woodie Flowers Award celebrates effective communication in the art and science of engineering and design.  Dr. William Murphy founded this prestigious award in 1996 to recognize mentors within the FIRST Robotics Competition who lead, inspire, and empower using excellent communication skills.  Dr. Murphy wanted to bring attention to the eloquent and effective communication skills of Dr. Woodie Flowers, so this award was created.

volunteerExperiences.description:
Annually deliver Southern Californian FIRST Robotics programs, trainings and 35+ events for over 5000+ children aged 5-14. 
Sustain recruitment, trainings and maintain 150+ event volunteers. 
Prepare, train and facilitate 300 coaches each season.
Non-Profit based with annual budget of ~1M.
Cohost an international event of 200 teams, impacting ~3000 children in STEM.

• Served as the Programming Mentor and Alternative Head Coach for FIRST Robotics teams at Poway High School and Mira Mesa High School.  
• Instructed students in coding, debugging, and writing reusable code in Java and C++, enhancing their programming skills.  
• Guided students in developing technical and non-technical presentations, fostering teamwork and communication.
• Awarded Woodie Flowers award in 2022 at San Diego Regional.
